title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E13 — Branch Battle: Navy
Four U.S. Navy officers must forge a multipurpose naval Mark 3 dive knife with metal from a giant anchor chain; two sailors return home to re-create the intricate and iconic naval officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E11 — Branch Battle: Air Force
In Round 2, four airmen from the U.S. Air Force must forge a bolo knife using the san mai technique to combine high carbon steel with helicopter parts; two smiths return home to forge an Air Force NCO sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E10 — Branch Battle: Army
Top bladesmiths from each branch of the U.S. military compete to earn a spot in a battle; four U.S. Army soldiers must forge a special forces V-42 stiletto; two smiths are dispatched to their home forges to build a U.S. Army officer's sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S06 E14 — Branch Battle: Finals
Tasked with replicating an iconic M3 Trench Knife from layered Damascus in only three hours; two servicemen persevere and head home to recreate a legendary sword: General George Washington's Lion-headed Cuttoe.

description:

title: Top Shot
description:
S04 E01 — Sweating Bullets
Two competitors are sent packing immediately after a surprise shoot-off; two shooters get a taste of WWII combat as they fire an M1 Carbine from a motorcycle sidecar.

title: Top Shot
description:
S04 E03 — Shotgun Showdown
Chris Reed returns to instruct the shooters on several modern shotguns; one team crumbles in the team challenge; a head-to-head shotgun battle sends one contestant packing.

title: Top Shot
description:
S04 E04 — Crossbow Crossfire
One team holds an urgent meeting in an attempt to reconcile their differences; an ultra-modern, high-power crossbow that fires bolts at a stunning 350 feet per second; the perfect pistol.

title: Top Shot
description:
S04 E06 — Blast From the Past
A mighty 3.2-inch bag gun cannon forces each team to work together; a heated grudge match pits two shooters against each other using the fast-flying prehistoric atlatl throwing dart.

description:

description:
S04 E05 — Swing Into Action
Teams employ pirate tactics in a challenge; a high energy battle that requires coordination and focus; two marksmen use one of the most durable pistols on the planet.

title: Top Shot
description:
S04 E02 — In the Trenches
Teams grapple with an explosive obstacle course and endure trench warfare conditions; two competitors duke it out in a fierce battle with a multi-shot grenade launcher.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E03 — Duck and Cover
The team travel to a local Las Vegas museum to do restoration work on a 1957 civil defence air raid siren; a client shows them a nickel-plated cash register from the early 20th century.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E15 — Late Night Chum
A Civil War cavalry jacket is brought into the shop; a man comes in hoping to sell a limited edition book signed by cowboy legend Will Rogers; Chumlee is forced to work the dreaded triple shift.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E24 — Cold War Cruisin'
Rick attempts to restore a 1962 Czechoslovakia scooter, and a mini 1930s oil tanker heads into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S05 E01 — Mile High Club
The guy's radar locks onto an L39 Albatross fighter jet; a guy slides in with a bat and glove signed by Babe Ruth; Rick and the Old Man are presented with a set of antique glass target balls from the 1800s.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S05 E05 — Buyer Beware
A man brings in a signed print of Abraham Lincoln; the guys are presented with a turn-of-the-century parade cannon; Corey and the Old Man find a steel mandolin from the 1940s.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S05 E15 — Crosby, Stills and Cash
A pair of WWII bomb fins are brought into the shop; a guy brings in a Martin guitar signed by Crosby, Stills and Nash; the guys continue their daunting search for a new employee to work the night shift.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E08 — Patton Pending
The team checks out a photo album signed by Gen. George S. Patton; Rick and Chumlee come across a pair of jockey boots autographed by Willie Shoemaker; a man comes in hoping to sell a bulletproof vest.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S05 E23 — Bear-ly There
The guys set their sights on a rare 1870 Volcanic pistol; a World War II gas mask made for the U.S. Navy is brought up to the counter; an early 1900s life-sized Steiff bear is brought into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E05 — Not on My Watch
A customer brings in a Confederate Civil War knife; a 1936 Rolex owned by Bernie Madoff; a 1950s arcade bowling game.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E22 — Missile Impossible
The Pawn Stars bring in a 1950s atomic missile pedal car; a client brings in a 1930s fare box, once used on public transportation.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E04 — Missile Attack
The team looks to buy a missile guidance system; a 1986 Buick Regal; a 1960s Playboy Bunny uniform; a 1980 Rubik's Cube sealed in the original package.

title: American Pickers
description:
S16 E15 — Catch-32
Mike and Frank have their work cut out for them on a huge property with more custom 1932 Fords than they have ever seen in one place; Danielle takes on an important military mission.
